text:
I know a strange and mighty hymn
that heralds dawn in the soul's night,
and these pages are cadences of that hymn
that the air carries through the shadows.

I would write it down, taming
humanity's rebellious, meager language,
with words that would be at once
sighs and laughter, colors and notes.

But it is vain to struggle; no sign
can contain it, and I could barely, O beautiful one,
even holding your hands in mine,
tell it to you alone, in your ear.

translation.title: Rhyme I: I Know a Strange and Mighty Hymn
